---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an enhancement (new query, measure, page, or capability)
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What would you like to add?**
A clear description of the feature — e.g. a new business query, DAX measure,
dashboard page, or pipeline step.

**Business value**
Which stakeholder or decision does it serve? (Keeps the project decision-driven.)

**Proposed approach (optional)**
Tables/measures involved, or a sketch of the SQL/DAX.

**Scope check**
- [ ] This fits the platform's decision-support scope (not replenishment automation)
- [ ] It maps to a stakeholder question in the BRD (or extends one)
